problem_text:
A logistics company must allocate its fleet of 8 specialized transport vehicles to deliver 8 distinct categories of cargo. The revenue generated per ton for each cargo type is as follows:
* For Cargo Alpha, revenue is 15.512 per ton
* For Cargo Beta, revenue is 14.819 per ton
* For Cargo Gamma, revenue is 8.562 per ton
* For Cargo Delta, revenue is 14.556 per ton
* For Cargo Epsilon, revenue is 6.449 per ton
* For Cargo Zeta, revenue is 5.859 per ton
* For Cargo Eta, revenue is 17.614 per ton
* For Cargo Theta, revenue is 14.012 per ton

The vehicle-hours consumed per ton for each cargo category are detailed below:
*For Cargo Alpha, Vehicle 1 requires 0.742 (ton-hours), Vehicle 2 requires 1.148 (ton-hours), Vehicle 3 requires 1.204 (ton-hours), Vehicle 4 requires 1.42 (ton-hours), Vehicle 5 requires 0.2 (ton-hours), Vehicle 6 requires 0.46 (ton-hours), Vehicle 7 requires 0.368 (ton-hours), Vehicle 8 requires 1.556 (ton-hours)
*For Cargo Beta, Vehicle 1 requires 1.014 (ton-hours), Vehicle 2 requires 0.557 (ton-hours), Vehicle 3 requires 0.874 (ton-hours), Vehicle 4 requires 1.405 (ton-hours), Vehicle 5 requires 1.03 (ton-hours), Vehicle 6 requires 1.183 (ton-hours), Vehicle 7 requires 1.888 (ton-hours), Vehicle 8 requires 0.921 (ton-hours)
*For Cargo Gamma, Vehicle 1 requires 0.386 (ton-hours), Vehicle 2 requires 0.393 (ton-hours), Vehicle 3 requires 1.504 (ton-hours), Vehicle 4 requires 0.762 (ton-hours), Vehicle 5 requires 0.407 (ton-hours), Vehicle 6 requires 1.601 (ton-hours), Vehicle 7 requires 1.8 (ton-hours), Vehicle 8 requires 0.384 (ton-hours)
*For Cargo Delta, Vehicle 1 requires 1.31 (ton-hours), Vehicle 2 requires 1.533 (ton-hours), Vehicle 3 requires 0.643 (ton-hours), Vehicle 4 requires 1.706 (ton-hours), Vehicle 5 requires 1.431 (ton-hours), Vehicle 6 requires 1.0 (ton-hours), Vehicle 7 requires 0.498 (ton-hours), Vehicle 8 requires 0.664 (ton-hours)
*For Cargo Epsilon, Vehicle 1 requires 1.693 (ton-hours), Vehicle 2 requires 0.502 (ton-hours), Vehicle 3 requires 1.468 (ton-hours), Vehicle 4 requires 1.228 (ton-hours), Vehicle 5 requires 1.209 (ton-hours), Vehicle 6 requires 0.229 (ton-hours), Vehicle 7 requires 0.421 (ton-hours), Vehicle 8 requires 0.758 (ton-hours)
*For Cargo Zeta, Vehicle 1 requires 1.335 (ton-hours), Vehicle 2 requires 0.887 (ton-hours), Vehicle 3 requires 0.662 (ton-hours), Vehicle 4 requires 0.891 (ton-hours), Vehicle 5 requires 1.034 (ton-hours), Vehicle 6 requires 1.27 (ton-hours), Vehicle 7 requires 1.208 (ton-hours), Vehicle 8 requires 0.862 (ton-hours)
*For Cargo Eta, Vehicle 1 requires 0.966 (ton-hours), Vehicle 2 requires 1.651 (ton-hours), Vehicle 3 requires 1.26 (ton-hours), Vehicle 4 requires 1.947 (ton-hours), Vehicle 5 requires 1.284 (ton-hours), Vehicle 6 requires 0.71 (ton-hours), Vehicle 7 requires 1.124 (ton-hours), Vehicle 8 requires 1.051 (ton-hours)
*For Cargo Theta, Vehicle 1 requires 1.735 (ton-hours), Vehicle 2 requires 1.527 (ton-hours), Vehicle 3 requires 1.785 (ton-hours), Vehicle 4 requires 1.492 (ton-hours), Vehicle 5 requires 0.656 (ton-hours), Vehicle 6 requires 0.691 (ton-hours), Vehicle 7 requires 0.495 (ton-hours), Vehicle 8 requires 1.782 (ton-hours)

* The cumulative operating hours for Vehicle 1 must not exceed 305.932
* The cumulative operating hours for Vehicle 2 must not exceed 244.835
* The cumulative operating hours for Vehicle 3 must not exceed 215.262
* The cumulative operating hours for Vehicle 4 must not exceed 322.938
* The cumulative operating hours for Vehicle 5 must not exceed 267.914
* The cumulative operating hours for Vehicle 6 must not exceed 218.834
* The cumulative operating hours for Vehicle 7 must not exceed 196.949
* The cumulative operating hours for Vehicle 8 must not exceed 154.041

Given the necessity to ensure that the total usage for each vehicle, from Vehicle 1 through Vehicle 8, does not surpass its respective available hours, determine the optimal tonnage allocation for each cargo category to maximize total revenue.
